name: Initial URL
description: URL to be scanned (GSA). BetaNYC: always `https://` + host + `/`; pages listed by a source are in `ny_page_urls`

name: Initial Base Domain
description: Base Domain of initial URL (GSA). BetaNYC: by the Public Suffix List snapshot in sources/2026-11-06/, so `.ny.us` hosts get one more label (`state.ny.us`)

name: Initial Top Level Domain
description: Top Level Domain of initial URL (GSA)

name: Branch
description: Branch of Government of the Agency Owner of initial Base Domain (GSA). BetaNYC: not yet filled; no source states it reliably

name: Agency
description: Agency Owner of initial Base Domain (GSA). BetaNYC: the owner of the host, from the first source that names one, in this order: registry, state agency listing, ABO, CISA, ITS 2023. Blank for shared hosts (several registry bodies) and for hosts named only page-by-page; see `ny_names`

name: Bureau
description: Bureau Owner of initial Base Domain (GSA). BetaNYC: not yet filled

name: Source List - Registry
description: Whether the host was sourced from data/registry.json (this repo)

name: Source List - State agency listing
description: Whether the host was sourced from a state agency listing (shared with BetaNYC privately; link private)

name: Source List - ABO
description: Whether the host was sourced from NYS Authorities Budget Office directory, data.ny.gov 4vym-q77x

name: Source List - CISA .gov
description: Whether the host was sourced from CISA .gov domain list, github.com/cisagov/dotgov-data

name: Source List - ITS 2023
description: Whether the host was sourced from NYS ITS Locality Hierarchy with Websites, data.ny.gov 55k6-h6qq, last updated 2023-03-06

name: NY - Initial Domain
description: The host as first listed, `www.` kept

name: NY - Entity IDs
description: Registry ids (data/registry.json) whose primary website is this host

name: NY - Names
description: Every owner name the sources give for this host or a page on it

name: NY - Levels
description: What kind of body each source says owns it: registry government_level, `state agency`, ABO type, CISA domain type, or ITS type

name: NY - Counties
description: County named by ITS 2023, when any

name: NY - Page URLs
description: Pages (not whole hosts) a source lists, e.g. a town page on its county's site

name: NY - Source Count
description: How many of the five sources list this host
